values.goal: Express document meaning and input contracts in markup, and check them with keyboard use, resource failure, and zoom.
values.capstone: An accessible learning-card document with headings, a table of contents, image alternatives, and forms

values.title: Meaning and Document Structure
values.environment: Frontory’s existing preview is a limited starting example, not a completed version of the whole assignment. Implement additional files and features yourself in a separate local project. Prepare HTML and any necessary image/media files in a separate folder and open them through a local HTTP server. Check with the Elements and accessibility panels and actual keyboard operation.
values.concepts.0.title: Heading Hierarchy
values.concepts.0.explanation: Headings express relationships between titles in a text. Choosing levels to change font size obscures the structure.
values.concepts.1.title: Region Semantics
values.concepts.1.explanation: header·nav·main·article identify roles within a document. Use links for navigation and buttons for actions.
values.outcomes.0: The accessibility tree distinguishes the main region from the navigation region.
values.outcomes.1: Explain the heading levels and navigation/action elements in 3 regions.
values.criteria.0: The accessibility tree distinguishes the main region from the navigation region.
values.criteria.1: Explain the heading levels and navigation/action elements in 3 regions.
values.steps.0: In index.html, prepare 1 page title and 3 topic regions.
values.steps.1: Divide a learning page into meaningful regions and distinguish link navigation from button actions.
values.steps.2: Run with 1 page title and 3 topic regions. Results to check: The accessibility tree distinguishes the main region from the navigation region. Explain the heading levels and navigation/action elements in 3 regions. Record expected and actual results separately.
values.questions.0: Where should you change font size?
values.questions.1: How do you distinguish independent content from a general grouping?
values.variables.0.name: Heading Level
values.variables.0.expected: Pre-run hypothesis: Heading relationships will appear irregular in the accessibility tree. Keep other conditions fixed and record the actual result separately after running.
values.references.0.title: MDN HTML

values.concepts.0.title: Document Mode
values.concepts.0.explanation: DOCTYPE tells the browser to interpret the document in standards mode. Omitting it may trigger quirks mode.
values.concepts.1.title: Characters and Language
values.concepts.1.explanation: charset specifies how characters are interpreted, while lang identifies the document language. These attributes address different issues.
values.outcomes.1: Check the Korean body text and tab title, and record the encoding value.
values.criteria.1: Check the Korean body text and tab title, and record the encoding value.

values.questions.0: How do lang and charset differ?
values.questions.1: Is DOCTYPE a regular HTML element?
values.variables.0.name: lang

values.concepts.1.explanation: strong expresses importance, and em expresses stress within a sentence. Use CSS when you only need bold or italic styling.

values.concepts.0.explanation: A relative URL is resolved against the current document’s base URL. Moving a folder can change the destination of the same string.
values.concepts.1.title: Fragments
values.concepts.1.explanation: A link pointing to an id navigates to a location within the document. Duplicate ids make the destination ambiguous.
